owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The addendum (recommendations 10, 11 and 12) adds fault classes beyond the F01 to F20 matrix of SO-11-A, a reproducible fifteen-step reference project as the integration gate, and the proof that local project execution needs no hosted infrastructure. This contract extends the acceptance programme rather than amending the signed SO-11-A: eleven named rows, the journey as one scenario with two stub sessions recording automatic, policy-gated or human per step, the invariant checker of SO-11-A AC05 over every fault scenario, and an offline run. Named tests live in test/*.test.mjs because the verifier and package.json run that pattern; test/acceptance/** holds fixtures only.

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-A-10 Fault injection and the reference journey: the failure matrix extended to F31, the fifteen-step journey as one scenario, recovery checked by the acceptance invariant checker, and the single-machine journey proven with no network path
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-10) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-1.10 (Fault classes: the addendum classes that F01 to F20 do not name, added to the failure suite); SO-1.11 (Reference project: the whole user journey as one integration gate) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-09-A†, SO-11-A†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-A-01, SO-A-02, SO-A-03, SO-A-06, SO-A-07, SO-A-08. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 11 (fault injection list), recommendation 12 (the whole user journey, 15 steps) and recommendation 10 (prove local execution without hosted infrastructure). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) The criteria with several named tests keep their own test name prefixes; the contract owns three test files, so its test_red_green criteria run the file named in each prefix.
